### CVE-2011-1468
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2011-03-20 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 35487: PHP < 5.3.6 'OpenSSL' Extension - 'openssl_decrypt' Ciphertext Data Memory Leak Denial of Service (dos/php, 2011-03-08, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 35486: PHP < 5.3.6 'OpenSSL' Extension - 'openssl_encrypt' Plaintext Data Memory Leak Denial of Service (dos/php, 2011-03-08, verified=1)

Multiple memory leaks in the OpenSSL extension in PHP before 5.3.6 might allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory consumption) via (1) plaintext data to the openssl_encrypt function or (2) ciphertext data to the openssl_decrypt function.
